original_interrupted_attempt.outcome: Owner stopped the incomplete run after a repeated legacy bond-table column error; it is not a complete suite result.

acceptance: The public experimental chemical_states.get_peptide_termini follows stored named N-CA-C and C-N graph relationships, preserving source indices under relabelling, atom/group permutations and explicit chemical-state selection.

Strict mode refuses ambiguous backbones; explicit report mode retains unassessed chains and their reasons without inventing fragment endpoints. Cycles have no free ends; real stored caps block their actual endpoints.

Native missing-OXT assessment, free N completion and explicit cap anchors reuse the shared rule. The legacy dictionary emits catalog MSM-WARN-BUILD-003 for every unassessed chain. Atom/group axes and component/stable-molecule distinctions remain tested.

Frozen 1BRS has actual interruptions in chains 3 and 4 (source label jump 63 to 66, no ordered native declaration). Native local repair adds four assessed heavy atoms (5151 to 5155) and preserves five OXT atoms; PDBFixer retains its independent 5230-atom/six-OXT profile. This documented scope difference replaces the unsupported parity assumption.
The Python addon exposes the native recognizer without changing the molecule or scene. Numeric/all H5MSM recognition avoids coordinate-series and interaction loads.

Two affected tutorials are actually re-executed (17 code cells plus separate private source/interpreter probes). The incomplete 1BRS coverage is visible despite the legacy warning-suppression opening cell. Foundations, Toolbox, Cookbook and course narrative/links are updated.
Three independent nine-node analytical graph oracles are registered; their narrowly declared claim does not certify chemical completeness, valence, protonation or geometry.
preserved_failures: Original seven-case control: four failures, three passes reproduce label-based endpoint movement, misplaced OXT, a missed stored cap and a false cyclic endpoint.

First implementation assumed a bond_type column in legacy two-column bond tables; owner interrupted after repeated failures, retaining partial events/log. Missing columns now remain explicit untyped evidence.

Early controls exposed a local imported set shadow, unsupported copy_if_all conversion keyword, a MolSysDict fixture containing untransportable mechanics, an unexported root Structures fixture class and a dative fixture with contradictory component-join metadata. Corrected controls preserve actual form contracts.
Real 1BRS integration forced the explicit strict/report distinction and diagnosis of its stored chain interruptions; prior failing parity assumptions are retained rather than relabelled as green.

The first scientific fast gate failed on a stale generated matrix; the first metadata amendment lacked its explicit claimed-symbol scope. The declared narrow analytical claim and generated matrix are now received.

The first scientific execution passes 109/110: its new fixture removed a positional bond row rather than the intended atom pair. The corrected independent oracle locates the declared C-N pair and the complete 110-case rerun passes.
A first systemd launcher used an unavailable MemoryOOMGroup property; no calculation started. The supported OOMPolicy=kill route enforces the verified cgroup memory.oom.group=1.
The first private 1BRS diagnostic could not JSON-encode NumPy indices; its fixed distinct attempt retains the measured graph.
limits: Observed named-backbone recognition is experimental. Untyped legacy edges remain admitted and reported; complete chemical state, stereochemistry, bond orders, force-field readiness and unknown missing links are not inferred.

An empty legacy dictionary under an unassessed-backbone warning does not certify complete terminal chemistry. Explicit capping requires one unambiguous linear backbone per selected covalent component.
The existing PDBFixer algorithm is independent. Its broader selection/context behavior is outside the native graph-recognition claim.

Original failures remain failures. Source cohorts are distinct: native/addon receiving 68954e6aa, generated metadata/HTML f8c516abb and final science b59ce29d560da1617cd8193d6945baea793c67ab; byte equality of native/addon/docs and existing affected tests is checked explicitly.
No native rebuild, dependency installation/floor/schema change, package/tag/Release/promotion, remote matrix or weighted-milestone bonus.
